edges.description: Built and deployed an automated trading system for Polymarket US and Kalshi prediction markets, then systematically tested four strategies from March 10 to April 7, 2026.
highlights: Tested passive market making, Pinnacle de-vig odds calibration, cross-market correlation, and WebSocket event trading
Found Polymarket US sports markets priced within about +/-0.8% of Pinnacle, leaving no systematic mispricing in the tested setup
Identified adverse selection and a roughly 26% round-trip fill rate as the main issue in passive market making
Built live market-making, paper trading, market scanning, calibration, cross-market logging, and shared market-making engine modules
Implemented 4-layer risk controls and maintained 639 unit tests across 36+ test files

edges.description: Built an automated Tock reservation sniper that monitors restaurant slots, enters high-speed polling around release windows, books the first available slot, and sends Discord notifications.
highlights: Implemented roughly 3-second sniper polling, release auto-detection, session pre-warming, and cookie persistence
Added adaptive concurrency, concurrent booking races, dry-run mode, selector verification, and slot release tracking
Designed Discord notifications for confirmations, detections, sniper activations, booking errors, and dry-run outcomes

edges.description: Built a self-hosted Mac Mini production server running automated systems with monitoring and self-recovery.
highlights: Configured pmset, launchd caffeinate, and per-process caffeinate wrappers for sleep prevention
Uses PM2 startup, PM2 save, crontab with NVM environment sourcing, auto-restart on power failure, Wake on LAN, and SSH
Runs a Discord monitoring bot through the OpenClaw gateway and manages the Tock bot, Polymarket system, and OpenClaw Discord gateway
Verified service recovery through reboot testing

edges.description: Built BoardGameOracle, a RAG-based Q&A system that answers board game rules questions with citations, multi-hop reasoning, and honest uncertainty handling.
highlights: Supports Splendor, Catan, Speakeasy, and Food Chain Magnate
Uses query rewriting, Pinecone dense retrieval, BM25 sparse retrieval, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, cross-encoder reranking, tier routing, and citation verification
Evaluation results: Splendor 91% accuracy, Catan 91%, Speakeasy 82%, Food Chain Magnate 79%, and Food Chain Magnate Tier 2 multi-hop 90%
Deployed as a single-service Docker container on Railway with FastAPI serving the React build

edges.description: Built the Resume RAG Chatbot, a portfolio-ready chatbot that answers questions about Yutian's resume with hybrid retrieval and Claude.
highlights: Uses BM25 and FAISS hybrid retrieval, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, query rewriting, Claude streaming responses, and source attribution
Alpha sweep via LLM-as-judge found pure semantic retrieval achieved 5.0/5.0 relevance
Frontend includes markdown rendering, collapsible source cards, dark/light theme, and typing indicators
Deployed as a full-stack Dockerized app on Railway

edges.description: Built the STA 221 Mushroom Classification project to classify mushroom images as edible or poisonous using a Kaggle dataset of over 3,000 images.
highlights: Compared Random Forest, Kernel SVM, CNN, and ResNet50 transfer learning
Random Forest reached 0.648 test accuracy after hyperparameter optimization
Kernel SVM reached 0.656 test accuracy
Concluded Random Forest was the most promising overall by accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and discriminatory power

edges.description: Built the STA 160 Wheat Classification project analyzing UCI seed data for Kama, Rosa, and Canadian wheat varieties.
highlights: Used visualization, correlation analysis, Leave-One-Out Cross Validation, grid search with Random Forest, and multiclass classification
Random Forest grid search reported 0.952381 training accuracy under the selected configuration
Compared multinomial logistic classification against One-vs-Rest methods using area and perimeter predictors

edges.description: Built the ECN 190 Information Cascades project investigating whether participants follow public predictions over private signals in a sequential urn-prediction experiment.
highlights: Reported 25 experimental rounds with 11 cascades forming, or 44% of rounds
Connected information cascades to herding behavior, investment patterns, marketing, and voting implications
Proposed a loss-aversion extension using larger penalties for incorrect guesses

edges.description: Built the STA 141B Covid Dashboard, a Covid-19 status tracker for country-level confirmed cases, deaths, and recoveries over selected time periods.
highlights: Included country comparison, global summary, status plots, and detailed country tables
README notes the original covid19api.com source is no longer working

edges.description: Built the STA 237A Covid and Vaccination Policy project assessing the effect of vaccination policy on Covid spread and whether policy effectiveness varied across countries.
highlights: Modeled vaccination policy as increasing-stringency dummies and Covid growth rate as new cases per million
Controlled for testing rate, compared ARIMA and ARIMAX models, and used gain in variance explained as a proxy for policy effectiveness
Planned ANOVA comparisons across countries and internal/external validation using held-out realized data
